▪ Overall Inflation rate has remained moderate at an average of 5.2% in both 2019 and 2020 and at 5.8%
in February 2021
▪ The weather outlook for the March-April-May 2021 “Long Rains” season indicates normal rainfall in
most parts of the country, hence low risk on food inflation in the 2H2021. However, energy fuel prices
are on the rise.
